about.title: About
about.body: I've been photographing seriously for a few years, drawn above all to the geometry and clean lines of architecture. I look for the frame that reduces a space to its essential shapes — that discovery, more than anything else, is what satisfies me. Every shot is an attempt to improve a little on the last. The prints you'll find here come from that personal pleasure, not a grand plan.
